name: What qualifies as a minor framing adjustment in home remodeling?

mainEntity.name: What qualifies as a minor framing adjustment in home remodeling?

acceptedAnswer.text: Minor framing adjustments involve modifying, shifting, or adding non-load-bearing structural wood or metal studs without altering the overall structural integrity of the home. Common examples include widening a doorway for a larger door, creating a pass-through opening between rooms, framing recessed niches in showers, or building out a half-wall or closet partition. Because Abraham Becerra and his crew handle in-house carpentry alongside drywall and painting, these adjustments are typically completed as part of larger kitchen, bathroom, or basement remodeling projects to improve room layouts and traffic flow.
acceptedAnswer.description: Minor framing adjustments involve moving, adding, or modifying non-load-bearing studs, such as altering doorways, adding closet partitions, or framing shower niches.
